	End_Dt as timestamp (),

	ExportFolder as string (),

source(output(
		NY_PA_pyID as string,
		MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		CALL_PHONENUMBER as string,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME as timestamp,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE as timestamp,
		PROVIDERID as string,
		PROV_PROV_FULL_NM as string,
		PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE as timestamp,
		EOC_END_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(4),@P_STARTDATE DATETIME,@P_ENDDATE DATETIME,@STARTDATE DATETIME,@ENDDATE DATETIME SET @CALLLIST_CD = \'381\' SET @P_STARTDATE = ? SET @P_ENDDATE = ?  IF @P_ENDDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @ENDDATE = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()) ELSE 	SET @ENDDATE = @P_ENDDATE  IF @P_STARTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @STARTDATE = DATEADD(DAY,CASE WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY,@ENDDATE) = 2 THEN -3 ELSE -1 END,@ENDDATE) ELSE 	SET @STARTDATE = @P_STARTDATE  SELECT NPH.NY_PA_PROVIDER_pyID AS NY_PA_pyID,NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE,\'\' AS PROVIDERID,NPS.PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME + \' \' + NPS.PROVIDER_LAST_NAME AS PROV_PROV_FULL_NM,NPS.PROVIDER_NPI,M.MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD,@CALLLIST_CD AS CALLLIST_CD,C.CALL_PHONENUMBER,C.CALL_CALLDATETIME,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION 		,NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CREATE_DATE,NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE AS EOC_END_DATE FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = @CALLLIST_CD 		AND CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)>20 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE END) BETWEEN @STARTDATE AND @ENDDATE 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_RPT_UNITJOB UJ ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID = UJ.UNITJOB_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE LCR ON LCR.CALLLISTRULE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_LOAD_CALLLISTRULE_IID 		INNER JOIN PDS_NY_PA_PROVIDER_HISTORY NPH ON NPH.NY_PA_PROVIDER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 		AND NPH.NY_PA_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 		INNER JOIN PDS_CALL C ON C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON C.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID 	                   INNER JOIN PDS_NY_PA_STAGING NPS ON NPH.NY_PA_IID = NPS.NY_PA_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER ORDER BY C.CALL_CALLDATETIME',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSProviderApprovalCalls
PDSProviderApprovalCalls split(TextFilesExportInd == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(ExportTextFiles,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
PDSProviderApprovalCalls derive(NY_PA_pyID_Unicode = NY_PA_pyID,
		MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD_Unicode = MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD,
		CALL_PHONENUMBER_Unicode = CALL_PHONENUMBER,
		PROVIDER_NPI_Unicode = PROVIDER_NPI,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,
		PROV_PROV_FULL_NM_Unicode = PROV_PROV_FULL_NM,
		CALLLIST_CD_Unicode = CALLLIST_CD) ~> ConverttoUnicode
ConditionalSplit@ExportTextFiles sink(input(
		PrescriberNPI as string,
		MARKET as string,
		EOCID as string,
		CALL_PHONENUMBER as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PrescriberNPI = PROVIDER_NPI,
		MARKET = MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD,
		EOCID = NY_PA_pyID,
		CALL_PHONENUMBER,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,
		CALLLIST_CD,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME)) ~> 381FlatFile
